plain: The lack of basic needs; hardship

webster.text: The state of being deprived; particularly, deprivation or absence of what is necessary for comfort.

more.text: The act of removing something possessed; the removal or destruction of any thing or quality.
The act of the mind in separating a thing from something appendant.

example.quote: To acquiesce in such a privation of their due importance in the political scale, would be not merely to be insensible to the love of power, but even to sacrifice the desire of equality.
